landing.learningGrows: Learning that grows with your child
landing.heroBody: YulMe helps children learn at their own pace—with playful activities, thoughtful practice, and progress parents can actually understand.
landing.adventureTitle: Learning should feel like an adventure.
landing.adventureBody: Every part of YulMe is designed to make practice feel encouraging—not overwhelming.
landing.personalizedBody: Practice adjusts around what your child knows and what they’re ready to discover next.
landing.confidenceBody: Celebrate progress with gentle feedback and achievable next steps.
landing.progressBody: Parents get clear insights without turning learning into a report card.
landing.parentTitle: Know what they’re learning. Know how to help.
landing.parentBody: Simple snapshots show strengths, growing skills, and where a little extra practice can make a difference.
landing.fourPromises: YulMe is built around four promises
